markup: Explain the 'Three Age System'
answermarkup:
i) The Three-Age System is a method of classifying pre-historic artefacts and antique objects based on the period to which they belong.
ii) It was introduced by a scholar named Christian Thomsen.

iv) The stone tools belonged to the Stone Age, the copper tools and articles belonged to the Copper Age and the iron tools and articles belonged to the Iron Age.
